focus.label: Idiopathic hypersensitivity/allergic dermatitis (no identifiable trigger)
focus.why: Current frontier node-6 ('Hypersensitivity or allergic dermatitis') is a broad category; the belief explicitly notes the absence of exposure history and serum IgE, so the specific trigger remains unidentified. An idiopathic hypersensitivity reaction is the most parsimonious fine-grained refinement, fully consistent with the supporting evidence node-2 (pruritic burning rash), node-4 (edematous coalescing/annular plaques), and node-9 (eosinophilia 11%).
